spans.s:
भू {vI.v} {c1c} P. (rarely Ā.) (भवति, बभूव,
अभूत्, भविष्यति, भवितुं, भूत)
1 To be,
become; कथमेवं भवेन्नाम; अस्याः
किमभवत्

‘what has become
her fate,’ ‘what has become of her’;

‘come
what may’; so दुःखितो भवति, हृष्टो
भवति &c.
--2 To be born or produced;
यदपत्यं भवेदस्यां

; यदि संशयो भवेत् &c.
--5 To live,
exist; अभूदभूतपूर्वः… राजा
चिंतामणिर्नाम Vās.; अभून्नृपो विबुधसखः परंतपः

.
--6 To be alive or living,
breathe; त्वमिदानीं न भविष्यसि Ś. 6;
[]
आः चारुदत्तहतक अयं न भवसि

(‘thou art a dead man’, thou shalt
breathe no longer);

.
--7
To remain or be in any state or
condition, fare; भवान् स्थले कथं भविष्यति

.
--9 To serve, do; इदं
पादोदकं भविष्यति Ś. 1.
--10 To be
possible (usually with a future tense
in this sense); भवति भवान्
याजयिष्यति Sk.
--11 To lead or tend to,
conduce to, bring about (with
dat.); वाताय कपिला विद्युत्… पीता
भवति सस्याय दुर्भिक्षाय सिता भवेत् Mbh.;
सुखाय तज्जन्मदिनं बभूव

.
--12 To be
on the side of, assist; देवा अर्जुनतोऽ
भवन्
--13 To belong or pertain to
(often expressed by ‘have’); तस्य
ह शतं जाया बभूवुः Ait. Br.;

.
--14 To be engaged in, be
occupied (with loc.); चरणक्षालने कृष्णो
ब्राह्मणानां स्वयं ह्यभूत् Mb.
--15 To
conduct oneself, behave.
--16 Ved.
To be prosperous, succeed. Used
with a preceding noun or adjective
भू serves to form verbs in the sense
of ‘becoming what it previously is
not’ or ‘becoming’ in general;
श्वेतीभू to become white; कृष्णीभू to
become black; पयोधरीभूत
‘becoming or serving the purpose of teats’;
so क्षपणीभू to be or become a
mendicant; प्रणिधीभू to act the spy;
आर्द्रीभू to melt; भस्मीभू to be reduced
to ashes; विषयीभू to form the
subject of; so एकमतीभू; तरुणीभू &c. &c.
Note--The senses of भू may be
variously modified according to the
adverbs with which it is connected;
e. g. पुनर्भू to marry again; अ विर्भू to
appear, arise, to be evident or clear;
see आविस्; तिरोभू to disappear; प्रादुर्भू
to arise, be visible, appear; अग्रेभू to be
in front, take the lead; अंतर्भू to be
absorbed or included;
ओजस्यंतर्भवंत्यन्ये K.

; दोषाभू to grow
evening or dusk-time; अन्यथा भू to be
otherwise, be changed; न मे
वचनमन्यथा भवितुमर्हति Ś. 4; पुरो भू to
come forward, stand forth; मिथ्या भू
to turn out false; वृथा भू to become
useless &c. &c. --Caus. (भावयति-ते)
1 To cause to be or become, call
into existence, call into being.
--2
[]
To cause, produce, effect.
--3 To
manifest, display, exhibit.
--4 To
foster, cherish, support, preserve,
enliven; पुनः सृजति वर्षाणि भगवान्
भावयन्प्रजाः Mb.; देवान् भावयतानेन ते
देवा भावयंतु वः । परस्परं भावयंतः श्रेयः
परमवाप्स्यथ

.
--5 To think or reflect, consider,
fancy, imagine.
--6 To look upon,
consider or regard as; अर्थमनर्थं
भावय नित्यं Moha

.
--8 To purify.
--9 To get, obtain.
--10
To mingle or mix.
--11 To change
or transform into.
--12 To soak,
steep.
--13 To devote or addict
oneself to.
--14 To convince.
--15 To
perfume, scent. --Desid. (बुभूषति) To
wish to be or become &c. {vII.v} {c1c} U.
(भवति-ते) To get, obtain. {vIII.v}
{c10c} A. (भावयते) To obtain, gain. {vIV.v}
{c10c} U. (भावयति-ते)^1
1 To think,
reflect.
--2 To mix, mingle.
--3 To be
purified (connected with caus. of
भू q. v. above).
[1] Correction submitted by on 20210621. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/548.

भू a. (At the end of comp.)
Being, existing, becoming, springing
from, arising or produced from, &c;
चित्तभू, आत्मभू, कमलभू, मनोभू &c.
--m.
1 An epithet of Viṣṇu.
--2
The sacrificial fire.
